entities.summary: Cavite State University is a public university in the province of Cavite, Philippines. Its 70-hectare (170-acre) main campus, known as the Don Severino delas Alas Campus, is located in Indang, about 60 km (37 mi) southwest of Manila. The institution has 12 other campuses spread throughout the province.
